fusions.name: Snagged Line
fusions.desc: Casts a snagging line to a point ahead of you for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Each enemy it catches is dealt 10 damage and stunned for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Reel
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed hook that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, adding 50% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Working the Barb Free
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and you regain 10 health.

fusions.name: Line Stays Taut
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
